text:
zoe_csm: Heads-up: Archimedes Labs dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. We need final quota, autoscale rules, a short soak plan, and a 20-min enablement for their SREs. Who's available? :wave:

harry_infra: I'll take infra. Suggested reserved = 9x A10 + ability to autoscale to 12 for bursts. Customer originally requested 6, we proposed 9 for buffer.

mina_sre: Autoscale knobs I'd use:
- scale-out +1 at avg GPU util > 68% for 2m
- scale-out +2 if request queue > 700ms for 90s
- scale-in -1 when util < 32% for 8m
- cooldown 3m, max 2 ops / 10m

alan_ml: Load mix: 45% chat (~900 tokens), 35% embeddings, 20% short gen. Seed set: s3://archimedes/onboard/seeds_v1.txt. QoE targets: p95 < 2.5s, error < 1%.

zoe_csm: @alan_ml paste the exact loadgen command we'll run and canary plan. Also need a brief notes doc for their oncall.

alan_ml: loadgen example:
```
loadgen --target https://dedicated.redwood/archimedes --qps 160 --duration 3600 \
  --profile mixed --seeds s3://archimedes/onboard/seeds_v1.txt --concurrency 48
```

alan_ml: Canary: 1 instance serves 5% traffic for 10m, then 10m ramp to 30% before full. If p95 > 3s during canary, abort and fallback.

harry_infra: Prewarm plan: compile kernels and populate KV cache 25m before start. Command:
```
./ops/prewarm.sh --pool archimedes --minutes 25
```

ops-bot: Provision scheduled: 1761114000  archimedes-dedicated-provision

tara_account: Confirmed with customer: they'll accept 9 reserved if week1 cost delta < 17%. I'll share estimate after infra posts instance-hour numbers.

mina_sre: Add fallback routing to hosted family if p95 > 2.8s for 3 consecutive mins. Also enable token-bucket shaping (burst window 300ms) to smooth spikes.

harry_infra: I'll tag logs with customer:archimedes and env:dedicated, stream perf to #ops-dashboard, and post expected instance-hours in 15m.

alan_ml: If 429s exceed 3%, reduce qps by 20% and check cache hit ratio. We'll capture sample outputs for a post-run quality check.

zoe_csm: Enablement call at 08:10 PT day-of (20m). Final go/no-go check at 08:40 PT. I'll send invites to archimedes-oncall@ and their infra. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
